title: APS4 - Business Analyst
text: APS4 - Business Analyst at DFP Recruitment (Townsville & Northern QLD, ; Contract/Temp; salary: Up to $37 p.h.). We are currently seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join this Federal Government Department based in Townsville. This will be an APS4 equivalent role. The role: The Business Analyst will provide assistance with the establishment and ongoing support of the Stakeholder Engagement Team of a Large Regional Hub. You will: Monitor communications and engagements through the stakeholder engagement tracker inboxes Consolidate all interactions and channels of communication including through integrating resources Maintain and update Contacts Register Prepare/extract individual or regional engagement briefs outlining previous engagement history for the region and/or the particular stakeholder, to enable and support sustained corporate relationships through periods of change; Establish and maintain individual Market Readiness profiles covering demand and supply, models of support, travel and accommodation logistics, telephone coverage, WHS provisions for remote travel, local contacts with local councils & State & Commonwealth departments Conduct and support thematic, quantitative, qualitative and cost analysis of Qld North data to inform policy positions or settings, assess risk, suggest solutions or otherwise support managerial decision making Coordinate and prepare all Stakeholder Engagement Governance reporting for National, Regional and Team forums Track and analyse issues, risks and performance; identifying areas for improvement. Responsibilities include: Coordinating and preparing reports against operational and governance KPIs. Tracking and analysing issues, risks and performance Providing advice on procedural changes as required to achieve or support improvements in KPI’s or other desired outcomes based on appropriate data analysis Coordinating preparation and submission of relevant data for all National and Regional Governance Reporting requirements Creating links between the engagement corporate and service delivery arms of the site office and being responsible for coordinating clear and regular communications back to National Office Design, conduct and/or coordinate data analysis to meet business needs, support investigation and resolution of complaints, inform decision making, or enable redesign of processes or achieve continuous improvement Ensure staff are following Agency guidelines and operating procedures. About you: The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following: Qualifications and/or demonstrated experience in a similar field Proficient use in Microsoft applications such as PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Outlook Experience in building relationships both with internal and external stakeholders Ability to adapt quickly to a changing environment It is highly desirable that applicants have an understanding of or lived experience in the field of disability. Entry Level checks will be required for all successful candidates and dependent on the role the appropriate working with children and/or vulnerable people checks may need to be undertaken as per State Legislation. If you are interested in this role, please APPLY NOW. By submitting an application you agree to our Privacy and Information Collection Policy located at www.dfp.com.au
